Esigie.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

An Ekasa verse recorded by Bradbury states that both Eguadase and Ogbelaka supplied Ewua officials and that Eguadase maintained an altar dedicated to Esigie.

Esigie.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine

Esigie.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
